text: 下面进入大作文 02 · 科技与现代生活母题：智能手机与数字化依赖的双刃剑答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：极富画面感的细节描摹与文字说明点题。
Instead of conversing warmly with one another, each person is staring fixatedly at their smartphone screen; a thought-provoking caption highlights the invisible barrier.
讽刺画面对比破题法：Ironically, instead of doing A, people are doing B fixatedly.
A thought-provoking caption highlights the invisible barrier erected by digital devices.
第二段：双刃剑利弊对比分析，揭示精神异化危机。
On the one hand, the boom of internet delivered convenience; on the other hand, excessive addiction has alienated authentic emotional ties between human beings.
辩证论述框架：On the one hand, ... on the other hand, excessive addiction has inexorably alienated...
Genuine dialogue and deep contemplation are gradually supplanted by fragmented trivialities.
第三段：总结提出理性驾驭原则与警示倒装句式。
Only by utilizing technology as an empowering servant rather than allowing it to become our tyrannical master can we preserve true warmth.
科技伦理主仆比喻倒装金句：Only by utilizing technology as a servant rather than a master can we...
Only by utilizing technology as a servant rather than a tyrannical master can we preserve warmth.
